V55.title: Cheeko Store
lines: He's finished everything on his Cheeko. Twice!
Say hello to the Cheeko Store!
Brand new learning videos, picked by you, right on your phone.
Guess the Dinosaur? Tap. Send to Cheeko!
Hold on! I'm learning new tricks!
It flies straight to Cheeko, over Wi-Fi.
And there's more! Guess the Instrument, for little musicians. Space Quiz, for star gazers.
Odd One Out and Cheeko's Riddles, for clever thinkers. What Is Missing, for sharp eyes. And Emoji Words, for new words.
Cheeko Store. A little more play, a world of learning.
